content: Root cause: The original implementation of the `ndo_set_vf_vlan()` function in the hns3 driver incorrectly handled the addition and removal of VLANs for Virtual Functions (VFs). It was designed to manage VLAN filters but did not account for the fact that VFs were unaware of these changes. The expected behavior was to enable or disable port-based VLANs, where the hardware would insert a specified VLAN tag into all transmitted packets for a specified VF. The patch corrects this by ensuring that when port-based VLANs are enabled or disabled, the appropriate VLAN filter entries are updated accordingly.
